title: .docmap.json
description: Options a repository states about itself, read by documentation.nvim's config.build. Every key here is a fact about the tree; options that belong to whoever opens the repository (keys, commands, watchers, telemetry) are deliberately absent — see lua/documentation/config/file.lua.

source.description: Directory or directories to scan, relative to the root. Omit to let the language backends detect it.

exclude.description: Repository-relative paths the walk does not descend into. Not a glob language: a path prefix.

languages.description: Backend names this scan may use. Empty or absent means all of them.

lua_root.description: Directory the Lua module path is relative to. Default "lua".

types_dir.description: Directory name holding type definitions. Default "@types".

out_dir.description: Where the artifacts are written, relative to the root. Default "docs/map".

tests_dir.description: Directory scanned for auto-derived test coverage. Default "TESTS".

features_dir.description: Feature files — see docs/FEATURES_FORMAT.md. Default docs/FEATURES, then docs/features.

checklist_dir.description: Release checklist — see docs/CHECKLIST_FORMAT.md. A directory of *.md, or a single .md file.

consumers.description: Directory of sibling checkouts whose maps name this project as a dependency. Enables consumer-require-missing.

title.description: Display name for the root node. Default: the repository directory name.

repo_url.description: Base URL source links are built from, e.g. https://github.com/user/repo.

branch.description: Branch used in source links. Default "main".

layers.description: Architecture rules. A module under `from` requiring one under `to` is reported as layer-violation.

from.description: Module prefix the rule applies to.

to.description: Module prefix it may not require.

why.description: Shown with the finding. Write the reason, not the rule.

checks.description: Per-check policy, keyed by the check code a finding carries. false switches it off; a severity re-grades it.

quicks.description: Tuning for the Quicks verdicts on the generated page.

thresholds.description: Per-verdict cut points, keyed by verdict id with hyphens written as underscores (test_coverage).

dead_code.description: Also report published functions with no caller in the tree. Off by default: a library is made of these by design.

calls_heuristic.description: Also emit call edges guessed by unique-name match. Off by default.

docs_heuristic.description: Also resolve doc references written as a bare function name. Off by default.

luals.description: Merge lua-language-server --doc output into the IR. Costs real seconds on a full tree.

luals_timeout_ms.description: Kill the lua-language-server run after this long. Default 60000.

snippet_max_lines.description: Lines kept per function's embedded source snippet.

badge.description: Also write coverage.svg beside the other artifacts.

godbolt.description: Experimental. Add a Compiler Explorer link beside every module and function in the page.

pdf.description: Also write overview.pdf via pdfport.nvim. Asynchronous.

theme.description: Theme baked into the generated page as the fallback. A reader's ?theme= still wins. Default "system".

max_depth.description: Deepest node level `mermaid tree` draws. Default 2.

deps_depth.description: Level the require graph is rolled up to in `mermaid deps`. Default 1.

cluster_depth.description: Node level `dot` draws subgraph clusters at. Default 2.

hops.description: Radius, in edges, of the neighbourhood kept around a named module. Default 2.

tag_files.description: Module prefix -> another project's docs/map-shaped directory holding a committed module_map.json.

external_repos.description: Module prefix -> "owner/repo", or a table with repo/branch/lua_root. Builds a guessed blob URL for a module with no artifact of its own.

telemetry_namespace.description: The runtime-analysis.telemetry namespace this project's data is filed under. Default: title.
